🚀 Mailu | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Self-hosting a private, feature-rich, and secure email server using Docker.
✨ Key Features: • Standard email server (IMAP, SMTP) • Advanced email features (aliases, routing, search) • Web access (Webmail, admin interface) • User features (auto-reply, fetched accounts) • Admin features (delegation, quotas)
📖 Summary: Mailu is a comprehensive, free, and open-source email server solution distributed as Docker images. It provides standard and advanced email functionalities, web access, and robust security features, making it easy to set up and maintain a private email server.
